svg.title: SPY strategy equity and drawdown at five basis points
svg.desc: 2013-01-25 to 2018-10-10. SPY buy and hold: ending NAV 2.072309; TimesFM mini (retrained): ending NAV 1.651011; TimesFM loop + adapter (retrained): ending NAV 1.344043; Multiscale residual mixer: ending NAV 1.156920; Regime linear experts: ending NAV 1.157316; Cash: ending NAV 1.000000. Initial NAV one is displayed as ten thousand dollars. Drawdown is measured from each strategy's prior peak.
